name: balatro-agent
description: Compact Balatro Copilot middleware over the upstream Balatro Agent bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Play Balatro with compact state and action feedback.
interface.longDescription: Three tools over Arcadi4's Balatro Agent v0.2.4: get_state, act and inspect. Preserves card IDs and effects, checks stale state and reads back actions without automatic retries. Requires Windows x64, Node.js, Steam Balatro, Lovely and Steamodded.
defaultPrompt: 查看我的小丑牌局面，解释关键决策并继续游戏。
